en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack stopping mid-task in a channel when an admin changed the channel's connectors, plugins, skills or rules; the change now applies once Claude finishes
zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了管理员更改频道的 connectors、plugins、skills 或规则时，Claude in Slack 在频道中任务执行到一半停止的问题；现在更改会在 Claude 完成后生效
